memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild fatigue after long drives, able to perform ADLs independently.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw normal).
falls: no falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular; polypharmacy not applicable.
mood: PHQ-9 to be checked; reports low mood, anhedonia for 4 weeks.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi, primary support.
goal: "I want to feel energetic and enjoy my work again."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: improved energy, drives 6‑8 hrs/day without excessive fatigue.

mood: PHQ-9 8 (mild); reports better sleep, still occasional low mood.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi.
goal: "I want to keep working without feeling down."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports occasional dizziness after standing quickly; otherwise able to manage deliveries.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (recall 0, clock abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full assessment.
falls: one fall at home 3 months ago (slip on wet floor); gait slightly unsteady; timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise balance exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 1 regular (sertraline 75 mg); not polypharmacy.
mood: PHQ-9 10 (moderate); reports increased anxiety, irritability.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi.
goal: "I want to stop feeling dizzy and be safe at work."

memories.text:

sertraline 75 mg OD
escitalopram 10 mg OD
